title: Hiro and the big white robot Baymax.
lines: A boy lives in a city with lots and lots of lights.
Hiro is fourteen and very clever.
Hiro lives with his Aunt Cass.
And he lives with his big brother Tadashi.
When someone says ow, Baymax comes to help.
Hello, I am Baymax, your personal healthcare companion.
On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate your pain?
Baymax has plasters, and a spray for pain.
He can take your temperature with his hand.
One day something very sad happens.
He sits in his room and doesn't want to see anyone.
He sees that Hiro is sad.
But he knows that hugs help.
He gives Hiro a big soft hug.
A man in a mask wants to wreck the city.
Red and strong, with rocket fists and wings.
Between the skyscrapers and above the bridge.
For the first time in a long time he's happy.
Together they form a team of heroes.
There's a girl who is fast.
And a funny boy in a monster suit.
They find the man in the mask.
But then there's still a girl trapped in a dangerous portal.
Baymax and Hiro go to rescue her.
Baymax gives his rocket fist to Hiro.
With it Hiro and the girl can escape.
But in the rocket fist he finds Baymax's chip.
